0022600174.text: The Wizards (3-3) are home for this game, sitting 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East after winning their last game, and they are 2-1 at home and 1-2 on the road. The Hawks (3-4) are 2nd in the Southeast, half a game back, 7th in the East, and coming off a loss, with a 1-2 home record and a 2-2 road mark. There are no games yet this season between the two teams, but in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 1-3 in the series, including a 126-96 loss in Atlanta in their most recent meeting. Washington is without Alex Sarr (knee soreness), Anthony Gill (back spasms), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Kingston Flemings (suspension).
